stem: Only one bench develops deficiency-like symptoms even though every bench receives the same nutrient tank. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Change the crop-wide fertilizer recipe first because a deficiency-like symptom on one bench indicates the shared tank concentration is insufficient for the crop
Increase concentration for every bench and compare recovery, because a localized symptom can reveal the first area to show a facility-wide nutrient shortage
Diagnose from the affected leaf pattern and adjust that nutrient across the room, because visible symptom location is more informative than local root-zone measurements
Compare local irrigation delivery, root-zone pH/EC and moisture, root condition, environment, and spatial pattern before making a crop-wide nutrition change
rationale: A localized pattern with a shared nutrient source suggests local conditions should be investigated before changing the entire fertilizer program. Delivery, root-zone conditions, and environment can all affect nutrient availability and uptake.
